rows.text: Good news! Your order from Hims is arriving two days early!
rows.note: After TORPEY: Texas / Talarico, JIMMY: more than people expected? TORPEY: By a lot, Jimmy. (SFX: DING) — quick swipe, then “Oops, sorry about that.”

rows.text: Your order of Hims erectile dysfunction pills has arrived. Got questions?
rows.note: TORPEY: So all eyes were on South Carolina where– (SFX: DING) — quick swipe. JIMMY: Do you need to deal with that, Dave?

rows.text: Dave Kolpaski, you said you had a flimsy boner, and Hims is here to help!
rows.note: TORPEY: Anyway, in Ohio– (SFX: DING) — quick swipe. TORPEY: Give me just one quick sec.
TORPEY pulls up the text chat on his phone, types it, swipes it away. Then: “Okay! All good. Let’s hop over to Maine, where–”

rows.text: Congrats! With your five-year supply order, you’re a Hims Gold member!
Your recent Hims order qualifies you for our new ‘Severe Case’ discount!
rows.note: TORPEY: Susan Collins was in a very tight race against– (SFX: DING) — quick swipe

rows.text: Your Hims prescription has been increased to the maximum legal dosage. Fingers crossed!
rows.note: TORPEY: Troy Jackson, who was hoping to upset the incumbent. (SFX: DING) — quick swipe

rows.text: Your request for a stronger pill has been sent to our Hims science department!
rows.note: TORPEY: And he did exactly that! It was a shock. (SFX: DING) — quick swipe

rows.text: We saw the pictures you sent us and we think you actually need “Hims Minis.”
rows.note: TORPEY: “I’m just getting so much spam! Talk about bad timing!” (SFX: DING) — appears behind him, no swipe. TORPEY: Actually I might take the week off.
